_note: Copy to <loop-dir>/runner.json. Point .promptTemplate at YOUR filled-in copy of iteration-prompt.example.md. {PROMPT_FILE} is substituted by run-loop.sh with the rendered per-iteration prompt. haltOnParked (default true) stops the whole run on any blocked/needs-human row; set false to skip parked rows and keep advancing actionable ones. The reopen/retry budget is a LOOP setting, not a runner one — set it in the scaffold's metadata.maxReopens (see prompts/reopen-item.md), not here. Both reference commands run fully autonomous (no permission prompts) so each fresh session can write files, dispatch subagents, and run its verify step unattended. Swap runtimes by editing .command only; change the model with --model (defaults: sonnet for claude, openai/gpt5.4 for opencode).
